integrity: The theorem is presented as a best-of-knowledge synthesis and extension of the cited ECT/minECT decomposition and the later color-basis line. Same-model review passed; no independent audit, proof-assistant verification, or expert attestation was performed.
scientific_limitations: The strong factorization concerns finite colorings of the natural numbers and standard finite-palette representations. The identification with minECT is claimed only for ordinary Weihrauch reducibility. Higher-order color-basis principles and infinite palettes are outside the result.
title: Exact palette certificates raise ECT exactly to the minECT degree
